risk_note: Admin console users pages to the finalized visual spec (apps/admin; no money logic; codex-run classed it RV2, so the Codex review ran on the money track). List: labels above the filter fields, an applied-filter bar with conditions and count in a polite live region, row actions named 详情 <UID>, monospace UIDs, horizontal scroll, empty / loading / error states as on AdmUsersStates. Detail: title row with UID and risk tag, bordered vertical basic information (the frozen admin-users tests accept only that structure), labelled read-only union table. Logic and requests unchanged; only contract fields. Prerequisite test-change F1-07k (#799). Rule tests by Codex in three calls plus one mechanical orchestrator fix (BROWSER#1 text check from exact to contains; counted as the one exception), Claude spec-test review pass, red on the test machine (red/3, 20 tests). Implementation by Opus 5.5 (one run cut off by a session restart without output, not counted); test machine verify-fast/3 and browser/4 (59/59) green. Review: Codex (approvals id 27 / 34). Written by hand.
